objectives: To elucidate whether probiotic oral bacteriotherapy attenuates oxidative/nitrosative stress, oxidative biomolecule damage, and inflammation in patients with non-communicable diseases.
inclusion_criteria: Randomized controlled trials in patients with non-communicable diseases characterized by inflammatory processes and oxidative stress; clearly defined probiotic intervention (single- or multi-strain) with dose and duration specified; placebo control; viable outcome data for oxidative/nitrosative stress or related inflammatory markers; adequate quantitative data (MD or SMD with SD/SE); clear diagnostic criteria; and at least three studies reporting at least one shared primary oxidative/nitrosative stress outcome.
exclusion_criteria: Studies not relevant to the topic or not reporting the clinical outcomes of interest; missing protocol or full text; non-viable primary/secondary endpoint data; non-RCTs or trials without a control group; animal or in vitro studies; non-NCD populations (including healthy, pregnant, overweight/obese participants); infectious diseases and inflammatory bowel diseases; complex chronic conditions with unclear underlying cause; probiotic interventions combined with another nutraceutical or unclear microbial composition; and active-control/placebo regimens that also contained probiotics, prebiotics, or other agents.
pmid_query: (("non-communicable diseases"[Title/Abstract] OR patient*[Title/Abstract]) AND (probiotic*[Title/Abstract] OR Lactobacillus[Title/Abstract] OR Bifidobacterium[Title/Abstract] OR Streptococcus[Title/Abstract] OR "Probiotics/administration and dosage"[Majr] OR "Probiotics/metabolism"[Majr] OR "Probiotics/therapeutic use"[Majr]) AND ("oxidative stress"[MeSH Terms] OR "nitrosative stress"[MeSH Terms] OR "oxidative stress"[Title/Abstract] OR "nitrosative stress"[Title/Abstract] OR GSH[Title/Abstract] OR hsCRP[Title/Abstract] OR SOD[Title/Abstract] OR catalase[Title/Abstract] OR GPx[Title/Abstract] OR MDA[Title/Abstract] OR TAC[Title/Abstract] OR TBARS[Title/Abstract] OR "8-OHdG"[Title/Abstract] OR "3-NT"[Title/Abstract] OR inflammation[Title/Abstract])) AND (randomized controlled trial[pt] OR randomized[Title/Abstract])
selection_evidence: The main manuscript Results section states that 15 studies were eligible and included in the quantitative synthesis: [1, 2, 7, 11-13, 15, 16, 19, 20, 22, 23, 44-46], with 807 participants. Table 2 lists the corresponding trial authors across endocrine/metabolic, neurologic/psychiatric, and other diseases, and Fig. 2 confirms 15 studies/16 trials. Table 5 later removes [11, 20, 44] only for a high-risk-of-bias sensitivity analysis, which implies those three references were still part of the primary meta-analysis.
notes: Conflicting snippets in paper_context.json and analysis_snippets.txt mention an 18-study set [14,15,22-37], but those lines come from unrelated supplemental material in this folder and do not match the target manuscript. I treated the target main manuscript plus its own supplemental Table S1 as authoritative. One manuscript-level inconsistency remains: the written exclusion text mentions chronic conditions such as hemodialysis, yet ref 22 is explicitly included in Results and Table 2, so the explicit included-study list was used as definitive. The pmid_query above is a cleaned reconstruction from the OCR-corrupted supplemental Table S1 search strategy.
